content: Yesu vamutuala kuli Pilato
Omo te cimene vakuluntu va tusasendote na vakuluntu, na valongisi va mezi a mashiko, na vaka mpunga voshe valiuanene nakukutata Yesu nakumutuala kuli Pilato.
Kaha Pilato uamuihuile nguendi, “Yove Muene ua Vayunda?” Kaha uamukumbuluile nguendi, “Omo vene munahandeka.”
Kaha vakuluntu vatusasendote vamuvangeyele vuima viavingi.
Kaha Pilato uamuihuile naua nguendi, “Kuuesi na cikumbululo ca kuhandeka ndi? Tala vuima vali nakukuvangeya.”
Vuno honi Yesu kamukumbuluile, kaha Pilato ualikomokelele.
Yesu Vamusompela Kutsa
Kaha ha ciuano uakele nakuvahumisila umo mukamenga uje vakele na kutonda vantu.
Kaha hhakati ka vinzinda vaje vakele mu kamenga, vaje vaka kutsiha vantu omuo ya mpindangano, hakele yala ivatumbuile nguavo Mbalambasa.
Kaha civunga cezile nakuputuka kulomba Pilato linga alinge ngue muje muakalingila kuli vakevo ntsimbu yoshe.
Kaha Pilato uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Mutonda njimihumisile Muene ua Vayunda ndi?”
Omuo uatantekeyele nguendi capuile kutonda lika kua vakuluntu vatusasendote linga vatuale Yesu kuli ikeye.
Vuno honi vakuluntu vatusasendote vashongangeyele civunga linga pilato ahumise Mbalambasa.
Kaha Pilato uahandekele kuli vakevo naua nguendi, “Kaha njilinge vika nou yala ou umutumbula ngueni Muene ua Vayunda?”
Kaha vatambekele cikuma naua nguavo, “Mushukike.”
Kaha Pilato uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Vika, vupi muka vuanalingi?” Vuno honi vatambekele cikuma nguavo, “Mushukike.”
Kaha omo Pilato uatondele kuvuahelesa civunga, uavahumisilile Mbalambasa. Kaha uapupile Yesu na kuvahanaye linga vamushukike.
Masualale Vashendumuna Yesu
Kaha masualale vamutualele mu lipela (mu cipango ca Nguvulu). Kaha vasanene voshe masualele.
Kaha vamuzikile ntanga ya vunengu, nakuzenga cilongo ca vimbimbo nakumuzika.
Kaha vaputukile kumumeneka nguavo, “Haaa, Muene ua Vayunda!”
Kaha vamupupile ku mutue na lihongo, nakumujekuila, kaha vatsikamene nakumulemesa.
Kaha hanima ya kumushendumuna, vamushuluile ije ntanga ya vunengu, nakumuzika vuzalo vuendi. Kaha vamutualele nakumushukika.
Yesu Vamushukika ha Cilindakano
Kaha valiuanene na yala umo ua lizina lia Simoni uaku Silene, uje uezile mu lifuti uapuile ishe ya Elekizanda na Lufuse, kaha vamusindiyiye linga ambate cilindakano.
Kaha vamutualele ku cihela vatumbuile nguavo Ngolongota (kulumbununa nguavo cihela ca cikola).
Kaha kuje vamuhanene viniu viakupandakana na miila, vuno honi Yesu kavinuine.
Kaha vamushukikile ha cilindakano, nakulipangezela vuzalo vuendi hhakati kavo, na kuta nkela linga vauane muntu na muntu ambataho cika.
Kaha yapuile hola ya mu citatu na viuana ku cimene, omo vamushukikile.
Kaha vasonekeleho canukiso ca kumuvangeya nguavo, “Muene ua Vayunda.”
Kaha vashukikile vezi vavali hamo na Yesu umo ku livoko lia cilio mukuavo ku livoko lia cimoshue.
Mu ngila eyi vene visoneka viapuilemo vije vihandeka nguavio, “Vamushukikile hamo na vaka vupi.”
Kaha vaje vakele nakuhita vamushauile, na kuningangesa mitue yavo, na kuhandeka nguavo, “Aha! Yove uasa kupihisa njivo ya Njambi na kuitunga naua mu matangua atatu,
liyoyese yove vavenia, kaha shuluka ha cilindakano!”
Kaha naua cifua cimovene vakuluntu vatusasendote na valongisi va mezi a mashiko vamushendumuine, na kuhandeka nguavo, “Uayoyesele vakuavo vuno honi kasa kuliyoyesa ikeye vavenia,
eceleni ou Kilistu, Muene ua Isaleli linga ashuluke ha cilindakano linga tumumone nakutsiliela.” Vaje vavamushukikile hamo nendi navakevo naua vamutengulukilile nakumushaula.
Kutsa ca Yesu
Kaha omo yapuile hola ya likumi na vivali ya mutania, kuakele milima ha mavu hoshe kutuala ha hola ya mucitatu ya mutania.
Kaha ha hola ya mucitatu ya mutania Yesu uasanene na lizi liakutambeka nguendi, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sambakatani?” Kulumbununa nguavo, “Njambi yange, Njambi yange, vika uanjisezela?”
Kaha vamo vaje vakele nakuhita omo vevuile eci vahandekele nguavo, “Taleni, alinakusana Eliya.”
Kaha umo uambuitikile mupelo mu viniu, naku haka ku lihongo na kumuhana linga anue, kaha uahandekele nguendi, “Vandameneni, tumone indi Eliya eja nakumushuluisa.”
Kaha Yesu uatambekele na lizi liakama, kaha uatsile.
Kaha ntanga ya mu njivo ya Njambi ya tavukile hhakati kuhuma kuilu nakuheta kuintsi.
Kaha mukuluntu ua masualale omo uevuile te alinakulila kaha uezile nakumona muje muatsililile kaha uahandekele nguendi, “Cilivene ou yala uapuile Muna Njambi!”
Kuakele vampuevo vamo naua vaje vakele nakutalelela kulahako, hhakati kavo kuakele Maliya Mandalena, na Maliya vaina ya Tiango shongo ya Yosefa na Salome,
vaje omo te hali mu Ngalileya vamukavele nakumukuasa kaha naua na vampuevo vavengi vezile nendi ku Yelusalema.
Yesu Vamutsinda
Kaha omo cinguezi cahetele, naua liapuile litangua lia kulivuahesela, litangua lije ntsimbu kanda sapalalo ihete,
kaha Yosefa uaku Alamatiya, uasingimikile vaka mpunga, kaha naua uavandamenene kuija ca vumuene vua Njambi, uasimpile nakuya kuli Pilato nakulomba muvila ua Yesu.
Kaha Pilato ualikomokelele indi nga Yesu natsi laja, kaha uasanene mukuluntu ua masualale nakumuihula ndi Yesu natsi laja.
Kaha omo uovuile kuli mukuluntu ua masualale nguendi natsi laja, uahanene muvila kuli Yosefa.
Kaha ualandele ntanga ya liniu, nakuneha muvila ha mavu, kaha uamuzengelele muje mu ntanga ya liniu nakuutsinda mu cihilo cije ca kucokola mu livue, kaha uasindumuinineko livue ku cikolo ca cihilo.
Maliya Mandalena na Maliya vaina ya Yosefa vamuene kuje va mutsindile.
